integrity.computational_support: Standalone standard-library independent direct additive-convolution comparisons, 240 parameter instances over fourteen fields.
integrity.math_proof: Exact convolution and character orthogonality; standard Hasse elliptic bound for large-field existence.

scientific_limitations: Odd prime-power fields only; only two distinct nonzero curvature graphs through the origin.
The fourth moment is for indicator functions, not a general weighted extension norm.
The elliptic trace has not been evaluated in elementary form for all field orders.
A stronger or unindexed equivalent published union-energy theorem remains a priority risk.
title: Exact fourth Fourier moments and a cube-root resonance for pairs of finite-field parabolas
